notes.title: Demo update and Next Fest
notes.content: [p]Next Fest Week[/p][p]The Demo is being fixed, I forgot to check the binary build when making the demo build after moving everything from UE4 to UE5. A binary build is much smaller, lighter and runs faster. I live in the country so the upload of the binary build is taking a second. Please check out the domo in the meantime, it's just a little big.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408240/The_Hive_Pandemic/"]"The Hive Pandemic"[/url] Starts on the Martian Colony Arionis, just like [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/915680/Jaws_of_Hell/"]Jaws of Hell[/url] but the hanger is a bar in 2054. JOH starts in 2033, but spans 21 years as Clark travels the stars. I wanted to add a look into the future, so now when you play through the hanger scene in the demo it glitches into the future and you see the bar until you leave the room.[/p][p]I did this by hiding all of the bar meshes at the start of the level and then unhiding them while hiding and disabling collisions on the jet when you walk toward them and then setting it back when you leave the room. Let me know what you guys think.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Next Fest Schedule-[/b][/p][p][u]-Wednesday Demo playthrough, Q&A[/u] on Steam[/p][p]-New video/trailer with gameplay footage throughout week[/p][p]-Thursday build a level together [url="https://discord.gg/PUv2mncJud"][u]Discord[/u][/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/915680/Jaws_of_Hell/"][u]-Friday game playthrough Q&A[/u][/url] Steam[/p][p]-Saturday Concert, live piano, guitar and make an AI song on [url="https://discord.gg/PUv2mncJud"][u]Discord[/u][/url][/p][p][/p]
